title: Crabface and the boat

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Are you gonna ask me about the boat?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you gonna ask me about the boat?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Floaty thing. Goes on water. You here about it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Floaty thing. Goes on water. You here about it?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: You and every other lubber in the LUZ. Well, it's your lucky day. The "Putter" is currently without a captain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You and every other lubber in the LUZ. Well, it's your lucky day. The "Putter" is currently without a captain.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: What am I, your skipper? Talk to Salt Pete. He's the one with the license. Just... use the lights if it gets dark. Last thing I need is another shipwreck.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What am I, your skipper? Talk to Salt Pete. He's the one with the license. Just... use the lights if it gets dark. Last thing I need is another shipwreck.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Then why you yapping at me? If you got a maritime license, you're captain of the Putter, all there is to it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then why you yapping at me? If you got a maritime license, you're captain of the Putter, all there is to it.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Cos I had a face and crabs ate it. Happy?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cos I had a face and crabs ate it. Happy?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Used to be a dock droid, working Curzona freight 'til the day a container knocked me overboard.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Used to be a dock droid, working Curzona freight 'til the day a container knocked me overboard.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Sure you are. Look, you want the boat, go talk to Salt Pete.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure you are. Look, you want the boat, go talk to Salt Pete.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Was down there a month before the other dockers found me and hauled me out. Some catch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Was down there a month before the other dockers found me and hauled me out. Some catch.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can give it a try.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can give it a try.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can give it a try.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can give it a try.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How did you make it back?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How did you make it back?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How did you make it back?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How did you make it back?
